normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- 2-5 blocks from the beach- 4-passenger golf cart- 3 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- This property come with 2 designated parking spaces dependent on the size of the vehicles. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: This quintessential Watersound beach cottage features professionally decorated interiors, vaulted ceilings, 2 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and beautiful accommodations for guests.The front porch gives guests a warm welcome and showcases modern Adirondack rocking chairs and a quaint turquoise front door. Inside, neutral decor, lots of windows, and an open floorplan make for a cozy and airy ambiance. The living area offers a wonderful place to relax with plush furnishings, and a mounted flat-screen television. Guests can enjoy preparing meals in the gourmet kitchen, boasting quartz countertops and elite stainless steel appliances. The adjacent dining area and breakfast bar feature seating for up to 8 guests and offer access to the nearby screened porch - the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee and the serene Watersound surroundings. The beautiful primary suite boasts an upholstered king bed, a flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a shower + additional shower/tub combo.Upstairs, you will find a guest room offering two queen beds and a private bathroom. Three custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes provide the perfect way to explore all of the wonderful local gems in Watersound and along 30A, including our world-class dining and shopping opportunities. Watersound's sugar-white sand beach and glistening emerald waters invite you to sink into a shaded beach chair and let the waves wash your cares away.Coastal charm and elegant accommodations await you at 225 Salt Box Lane. Start planning your dream 30A stay in this incredible home!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower + additional Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboIMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW. *This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.* To ensure a comfortable stay for all guests, pets are not permitted on the property. Please note that any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.*The Big Green Egg is not for guest use.*No Smoking

This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: This quintessential Watersound beach cottage features professionally decorated interiors, vaulted ceilings, 2 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and beautiful accommodations for guests. The front porch gives guests a warm welcome and showcases modern Adirondack rocking chairs and a quaint turquoise front door. Inside, neutral decor, lots of windows, and an open floorplan make for a cozy and airy ambiance. The living area offers a wonderful place to relax with plush furnishings, and a mounted flat-screen television. Guests can enjoy preparing meals in the gourmet kitchen, boasting quartz countertops and elite stainless steel appliances. The adjacent dining area and breakfast bar feature seating for up to 8 guests and offer access to the nearby screened porch - the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee and the serene Watersound surroundings. The beautiful primary suite boasts an upholstered king bed, a flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a shower + additional shower/tub combo. Upstairs, you will find a guest room offering two queen beds and a private bathroom. Three custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes provide the perfect way to explore all of the wonderful local gems in Watersound and along 30A, including our world-class dining and shopping opportunities. Watersound's sugar-white sand beach and glistening emerald waters invite you to sink into a shaded beach chair and let the waves wash your cares away. Coastal charm and elegant accommodations await you at 225 Salt Box Lane. Start planning your dream 30A stay in this incredible home!
